reason: No regulator requires agent-level controls yet, and when the examiners asked how we use AI, we answered with our existing model-risk and supervision policies. I don't spend budget on a control nobody is asking me to evidence.
objection: You want to put a proxy with no customers and no SOC 2 into our trade and payment path. Our third-party risk review would stop that before I could even argue for it, and the free pilot still makes me sign a letter of intent naming a price.
would_change_my_mind: An examiner or a FINRA notice explicitly asking us to show controls and an audit trail for customer AI agents, together with a finished SOC 2 Type II report.
